page.layout: One printed page of the scan: a blind-tooled leather book cover (front board) with decorative frames and a dark ink stamp or label at the centre. No text block. Two metal clasps at the left edge and raised bands on the spine at the right.
page.notes: The scan shows the outside of a bound book (binding), not a text page. The only marks are a dark ink blotch at the centre, a few red stains near the lower centre, and a small pencil-like mark lower right. None of these is legible printed text, so nothing is transcribed. The blind-tooled ornament on the boards is decoration, not print.
